name: Schema Publication and Discovery
description: Schemas are published, versioned, and discoverable at stable URLs. Includes schema documentation generation.
purpose: External consumers can find and understand schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: Each schema published at a stable, versioned URL
Schema index page lists all published schemas with version metadata
Documentation generated from schema definitions (field descriptions, examples)
Discovery endpoint returns searchable/filterable schema listing
Publication pipeline runs automatically on schema changes
Published schemas include changelog and migration guide links
